The '''2008–09 Primeira Liga''' was the 75th season of the [[Primeira Liga]], the top professional league for Portuguese [[association football]] clubs. It began on 22 August 2008 and ended on 24 May 2009. [[FC Porto|Porto]] was the three-time defending champions and secured a fourth consecutive title for the second time in its history.

==Promotion and relegation==

===Teams relegated to Liga de Honra===
*[[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]]
*[[U.D. Leiria|União de Leiria]]

[[U.D. Leiria|União de Leiria]] have been relegated to the [[Liga de Honra]] after finishing in last place in [[2007–08 Primeira Liga]].

[[Boavista F.C.|Boavista]] were also relegated as a punishment for their participation in a match fixing scandal in [[2003–04 Primeira Liga|2003–04 season]]. Accordingly, [[F.C. Paços de Ferreira|Paços de Ferreira]], which was originally scheduled to be relegated, was saved from demotion.

===Teams promoted from Liga de Honra===
*[[C.D. Trofense|Trofense]]
*[[Rio Ave F.C.|Rio Ave]]

Leiria and Boavista were replaced by two promoted teams from Liga de Honra. The first was [[C.D. Trofense|Trofense]], which clinched the second level title. This was its first appearance in Primeira Liga.

Trofense was accompanied by [[Rio Ave F.C.|Rio Ave]], which returned to the Primeira Liga after two seasons in the Liga de Honra.
